product_overview: Born Citius is an offline-first PWA and web workflow system for field technicians to complete assigned job cards, capture watermarked photo evidence, upload supporting documents, and submit work for review. It also lets reviewers approve or reject submitted tasks and export approved job documentation.
core_goals: Technicians can sign in and access only their assigned tasks.
Technicians can complete task forms on mobile, including text, date, GPS, photo, and document inputs.
Technicians can capture photos with embedded watermark metadata for evidence.
Technicians can work offline and have changes sync automatically when connectivity returns.
Technicians can submit completed tasks for review.
Reviewers can approve tasks or reject specific fields with comments for revision.
Approved tasks can be exported as finalized documents.

features.name: Login
features.description: Technicians sign in with email and password to access their assigned work.
user_flows: Navigate to /masuk -> Fill in email -> Fill in password -> Submit login form -> See the task list
Navigate to /masuk -> Enter invalid credentials -> Submit login form -> See an inline error message

features.name: Logout
features.description: Signed-in users can end their session from the task list page.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Select logout -> Return to the sign-in screen

features.name: Task List
features.description: Technicians view the list of assigned, in-progress tasks and open a task to continue work.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> See assigned tasks -> Open a task -> Arrive at the task form
Navigate to / -> Tap the sync indicator -> Observe pending items drain when sync is available

features.name: Task Form Field Entry
features.description: Technicians fill task fields such as text, number, date, textarea, and GPS inputs with offline-first autosave.
user_flows: Navigate to /tugas/:taskId -> Fill in text, number, date, or textarea fields -> Capture GPS for a location field -> See the entered values saved for the task
Navigate to /tugas/:taskId -> Attempt GPS capture when location access is denied or unavailable -> See a fallback GPS value saved in the field

features.name: Photo Capture with Watermark
features.description: Technicians capture or select photos for a task, with camera photos burned in with watermark metadata.
user_flows: Navigate to /tugas/:taskId -> Capture a photo with the camera -> See the photo added with a watermark
Navigate to /tugas/:taskId -> Choose a photo from the gallery -> See the photo attached to the task
Navigate to /tugas/:taskId -> View uploaded photo thumbnails -> Delete a photo attachment -> See the attachment removed

features.name: Document Upload
features.description: Technicians upload scanned documents or signed-document files for a task field and manage uploaded attachments.
user_flows: Navigate to /tugas/:taskId -> Upload a scanned image or PDF document -> See the document attached to the task
Navigate to /tugas/:taskId -> Open an uploaded attachment -> View the document
Navigate to /tugas/:taskId -> Delete an uploaded attachment -> See the attachment removed

features.name: Offline Queue & Background Sync
features.description: Field edits and photo uploads are queued locally and synchronized automatically when the browser goes back online.
user_flows: Navigate to /tugas/:taskId -> Go offline -> Make field edits or capture photos -> See changes queue instead of failing
Navigate to / -> Observe the sync indicator change to show pending items -> Come back online -> See the queue drain automatically

features.name: Task Submission
features.description: Technicians submit completed tasks after local and queued changes have been sent successfully.
user_flows: Navigate to /tugas/:taskId -> Complete the form -> Submit the task -> Return to the task list and see the task removed from the active list
Navigate to /tugas/:taskId -> Submit while queued items cannot be sent -> See an error toast and remain on the form

features.name: Offline Fallback Page
features.description: When a task page cannot be loaded from cache and the network is unavailable, a static offline reassurance page is shown.
user_flows: Attempt to open an uncached page while offline -> See the offline reassurance page

tech_stack: Next.js 16 (App Router, Server Actions, Server Components)
Manual Service Worker (public/sw.js, no next-pwa) — PWA offline support
httpOnly cookie session (bct_access/bct_refresh) + one readable bct_name cookie for watermark attribution

routes.description: "Tugas Saya" — technician's task list, excludes submitted/approved tasks; offline-viewable once loaded once
Login screen ("masuk" = sign in); redirects to / if already authenticated
Static service-worker fallback page shown when a navigation isn't cached and the network fetch fails
Main job-card/BAST form — fill fields, capture watermarked photos, upload documents, submit; core offline-first surface

features.name: Login
features.description: Email/password login for technicians; sets three cookies (bct_access 15min, bct_refresh 30day, bct_name for watermark attribution)
user_interactions: Fill email input
Fill password input
Click "Masuk" to submit (button disabled + spinner while pending)
See inline error alert on invalid credentials or network failure

features.name: Logout
features.description: Ends the session from the task list page
user_interactions: Click "Keluar" button on the task list

features.name: Task List
features.description: Lists the technician's assigned/in-progress tasks; completed (submitted/approved) tasks disappear from the list; viewable offline once previously loaded
user_interactions: Tap a task row to navigate to /tugas/:taskId
Tap the sync indicator pill to manually trigger a queue drain when items are pending

features.name: Task Form — Field Entry (offline-first autosave)
features.description: Fill text/number/date/textarea/GPS fields; each edit is debounced 700ms then written to the local offline queue immediately, independent of connectivity, and synced to the server in the background
user_interactions: Type into a text/number/date/textarea field
Click "Ambil" on a GPS field to capture current location (falls back to "GPS tidak aktif"/"GPS tidak tersedia" string if denied/unavailable — this is a valid saved value, not a failure)
(Revision mode, status=rejected) see approved fields locked/disabled, rejected fields highlighted with the reviewer's comment

features.name: Photo Capture with Watermark
features.description: Camera capture burns a timestamp/GPS/technician-name watermark directly into the image pixels (not EXIF); gallery-picked photos are compressed but not watermarked. Both paths enqueue offline and sync when possible.
user_interactions: Click "Ambil Foto" to open the camera (environment-facing) and capture a photo
Click "Dari Galeri" to pick an existing photo from the device gallery
View thumbnails of already-uploaded photos
Click the X on a thumbnail to delete it (browser confirm dialog) — this is an immediate network call, NOT offline-queued; will fail if offline

features.name: Document Upload
features.description: Upload a scanned document or signed-document file for a field
user_interactions: Click "Upload Scan Dokumen" and choose an image/PDF file
Click an existing attachment link to view it
Click the delete button on an attachment (immediate network call, not offline-queued)

features.name: Offline Queue & Background Sync
features.description: Dexie/IndexedDB queue (db: born-citius-teknisi, table items) holding pending field-value and attachment writes; auto-drains on the browser 'online' event, every 20s as a fallback poll, and on manual sync-button tap. Failed items retry indefinitely (no backoff/max-attempts cap).
user_interactions: Observe the sync indicator pill change between offline (amber), pending-N (blue, tappable), and synced (green)
Go offline (airplane mode / devtools network throttling), make field edits or take photos, confirm they queue instead of erroring
Come back online and observe the queue auto-drain without user action

features.name: Task Submission
features.description: Drains the offline queue first; if anything fails to send, submission is aborted client-side with a toast and no server call is made. On success, navigates back to the task list.
user_interactions: Click the fixed bottom "Submit Tugas" button
See a toast error ("Gagal mengirim. Periksa koneksi Anda.") if offline or if any queued item failed to send
On success, land back on the task list with the task no longer shown

features.name: Offline Fallback Page
features.description: Service-worker-served static page shown when a navigation is not cached and the network is unreachable; reassures the technician their data/photos are safe and will send automatically
user_interactions: (passive) view the offline reassurance message; no interactive elements

known_limitations.issue: No access-token refresh mechanism — bct_access cookie expires after 15 minutes and bct_refresh is stored but never sent to a refresh endpoint (only to /auth/logout)
known_limitations.impact: A technician mid-form for 15+ minutes gets redirected to /masuk on next navigation, though offline-queued field/photo data survives independently in IndexedDB since the queue doesn't depend on the page session

known_limitations.issue: Attachment deletion is not offline-safe — it's a direct immediate fetch, not routed through the offline queue
known_limitations.impact: Deleting a photo/document while offline fails with a toast and is not retried/queued

known_limitations.issue: Offline queue retries have no cap or backoff — a permanently-invalid queued item could retry forever
known_limitations.impact: drainQueue runs every 20s plus on 'online' events plus on manual sync plus on submit attempts, with no max-attempts abandonment

known_limitations.issue: Task detail pages are only available offline if previously visited/prefetched while online (via PrefetchTasks warming on the task list, or a manual visit)
known_limitations.impact: A technician who never had signal before going to a task for the first time gets the /offline fallback instead of the form — intentional per SW comments (avoids serving stale HTML without matching JS chunks), but a real coverage gap worth testing explicitly

known_limitations.issue: Multipart/form-data attachment uploads bypass the proxy's request-body size guard (MAX_BODY_BYTES only checks JSON bodies)
known_limitations.impact: Oversized photo/document uploads rely entirely on the downstream API's own limit enforcement, not the proxy
